name: Photonic Gamma Distortion Executioner
description: The omni-system lighting incinerator. Authentic physical optics (glass lenses, physical sensors) metabolize and transmit light obeying strict, biologically-anchored non-linear Gamma curve laws. Splicing software and AI hallucination vats routinely tear these photonic theorems to shreds by indiscriminately assigning uncalibrated luminance intensities. This system drags the image’s light spectrum into a clinical tribunal to ask: Has the color gradient been violently, forcibly snapped (Fake Gamma Correction) by an editor trying to hastily match a dark spliced face into a blazing sunset?
algorithm: Statistical Anomaly Inverse Gamma Mapping & Comb-Effect Extraction
mechanism: It eviscerates the light transfer power-law 'Vout = A * Vin^gamma'. Original Photons traveling through genuine glass cascade like pristine silk. But if a digital assassin deploys Photoshop 'Curves/Levels' to artificially blast light into a murky, spliced subject, the native Gamma curve violently snaps, resulting in a horrifically jagged, fractured structure. The resulting 'Comb Effect' (Histogram gaps and spikes spawned by artificial Gamma warping) issues an instantaneous execution warrant against amateur editors.
parameters: Operator: Inverse Gamma Histogram Comb Response, Forensic Scalpel: Peak-to-Gap Missing Value Matrix
accuracy: Lethal Precision (86-93%) - A merciless executioner showing zero quarter to ANY artificial brightness tweaking or malicious Shadow Hacking tools across the globe.
source: Farid (2001) - Blind Forensic Identification of Non-Linear Gamma Operations
useCase: Brings the hammer violently down on sloppy splice-jobs where the perpetrator frantically grinds out manual Curves / Levels / Exposure adjustments desperately trying to make two alien lighting sources match. The harder they edit, the deeper Gamma destroys them.

references.title: Farid, H. (2001). Blind inverse gamma correction. IEEE TIP.
Gonzalez, R.C. & Woods, R.E. (2018). Digital Image Processing. 4th Edition. Pearson.
Farid, H. (2009). Exposing digital forgeries from JPEG ghosts. IEEE TIFS.

strengths:
• Attempting to camouflage a splice with heavy lighting tweaks is literal suicide against Gamma Distortion. The harder you manipulate brightness to fool the human eye, the more catastrophically this mathematical blade guts your forgery.
• Hyper-sonic processing speed, as it reads the macro-Histogram metadata structure instead of agonizingly traversing every single raw pixel.
limitations:
• The precision blade violently deflects and misses if the malicious actor shot entirely in pure RAW format, and homogeneously re-rendered the entire image with a fresh, pristine unified Gamma curve from the ground up without malicious splicing.
• Horrifically crushed by brutal lossy JPEG compression, which spawns massive block artifacts that suffocate and erase the delicate, jagged Gamma 'Comb' errors entirely.
